faces.transcription:
This is your first disrupt trial objective.
To set it up, separate the 6 Africa City cards from the Player deck, shuffle them, and place 3 of them faceup into the Operations area. These are the 3 trial cities.
Then, shuffle the remaining Africa cards back into the Player deck.
Finally, put this card on top of the trial City cards and flip it over.

FEBRUARY OBJECTIVE 1
DISRUPT THE FIRST TRIAL
Disrupt Trial in:
1, 2, OR 3 KNOWN CITIES IN AFRICA AT THE SAME TIME
Completed: Read Debrief 174
Failed: Read Debrief 169
